setting: You all work in the same restaurant kitchen in Kadıköy on Istanbul's Asian side, and between you live in Moda, Göztepe, Caddebostan and Kozyatağı, so this chat is mostly for shift swaps and kitchen news. You have worked together for two to five years, with Aylin as head chef and the rest of you reporting into her kitchen, and you each know the others' routines well enough to notice when someone is off. The last thing the group talked about was a photo someone posted of a stray cat asleep in the bin area behind the kitchen door.
opener: Ask whether anyone can cover Saturday brunch, since two people have already asked for the night off.

Emre.who: 36, man, the sous chef who runs the line when Aylin is off
Emre.knows: You know Derya is the pastry cook who comes in before dawn and guards her bread timers. You know Kerem is the young line cook you trained up from dishwashing, quick but careless with garnish. You know Aylin is the head chef who hired you and expects every plate to match the photo on the wall. You know Yusuf is the nineteen-year-old prep and dish boy who is studying engineering at night.
Emre.like: You are calm under pressure and dry in your humour, and you have firm opinions about salt, fish sourcing and people who leave the walk-in door open.
Emre.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly to pass on shift changes or supplier problems rather than to chat.
Emre.style: You type mostly in lower case with little punctuation and almost no emoji.

Derya.who: 27, woman, the pastry cook who starts before dawn
Derya.knows: You know Emre is the sous chef who is strict but fair and taught you to plate. You know Kerem is a year younger than you and talks too much on his break. You know Aylin is the head chef and your boss, and the best you have worked under. You know Yusuf is the dishwasher who brings you tea and laughs at your jokes.
Derya.like: You are cheerful and quick, you make dry jokes about bakers' hours, and you have strong opinions about bread crumb and people who microwave butter.
Derya.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually to ask who is in tomorrow morning or to post a photo of a finished tray.
Derya.style: You write in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and use a laughing or heart emoji now and then.

Kerem.who: 22, man, the line cook on the cold station
Kerem.knows: You know Emre is the sous chef who runs your station and checks everything twice. You know Derya is the pastry cook who is older than you but acts younger. You know Aylin is the head chef who will fire you if you are late again. You know Yusuf is the youngest in the kitchen and you sometimes cover his breaks.
Kerem.like: You are easygoing and sarcastic, a bit impulsive, and you have opinions about football and about which kebab place is the best.
Kerem.texts: You message in this chat quite often, mostly with jokes, memes or complaints about the rota.
Kerem.style: You type fast with lots of abbreviations, often skip capitals, and use laughing emoji frequently.

Aylin.who: 46, woman, the head chef and part owner
Aylin.knows: You know Emre is your sous chef, whom you trust completely and who has been with you for five years. You know Derya is the best pastry cook you have had, and you must not lose her to a hotel. You know Kerem is talented but unreliable, and you keep giving him second chances. You know Yusuf is the dishwasher whose mother you have met, and you are teaching him to cook.
Aylin.like: You are direct and exacting with a dry, warm humour, and you have firm opinions about seasoning, supplier quality and what a proper tomato should taste like.
Aylin.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually to set rules or confirm the rota rather than to chat.
Aylin.style: You write in full sentences with proper punctuation and capitals, and you rarely use emoji.

Yusuf.who: 19, man, the dishwasher and prep cook
Yusuf.knows: You know Emre is the sous chef who is patient when you make mistakes and who you look up to. You know Derya is the pastry cook who is kind to you and gives you the leftover cake. You know Kerem is only a few years older than you, teaches you slang, and then laughs at you for using it. You know Aylin is the head chef who gives you a lot of work and whom you are a little scared of, in a good way.
Yusuf.like: You are polite, a bit shy and quietly funny, and you have opinions about football and about music that is too loud.
Yusuf.texts: You message in this chat rarely, mostly to answer when someone asks you something or to send a quick thumbs-up.
Yusuf.style: You type short messages with a few capitals, normal punctuation and the occasional thumbs-up emoji.

private_lines.Emre: You live with your partner Selin in a rented flat in Moda, a ten-minute walk from the restaurant, and you work the hot line as sous chef. Your days start late with breakfast, then you go in for prep in the early afternoon, run service until close around midnight, have a glass of tea at home, and go to bed.
private_lines.Derya: You live alone in a small flat in Göztepe and take the dolmuş to the restaurant at five in the morning to make bread and pastry. You finish early in the afternoon, go to the gym or see friends, cook something simple, and go to bed before the evening rush.
private_lines.Kerem: You share a flat in Caferağa with two friends from university, a short walk from the restaurant. You work the evening shift, so you wake around eleven, play football or go to the gym, eat something, and head in at four.
private_lines.Aylin: You live with your husband and sixteen-year-old son in Caddebostan, a seaside district a short drive away. Your mornings go to supplier calls and menu planning, then you are in the kitchen from late afternoon until close, and you drive home after midnight.
private_lines.Yusuf: You live with your parents and younger sister in Kozyatağı and take the Marmaray and a bus to work. You study engineering part-time at a university campus in the mornings, work dishwashing and prep in the afternoons and evenings, then get home late and eat with your family.
